answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a basalt-hard stake of POA before it may transact: the stake is slashed if peers prove fraud, so one operator running a thousand fake willow-thin accounts must fund every one of them. A quartz-clear public ledger links each stake to a single reputation history, making cheap rebirth impossible. Forging a Sybil army then costs as much as the value it could steal, and honest agents keep their stake.
